summary: End-to-end testing of Fortune U Group financial site (backend + frontend). All 25 pytest backend tests pass (100%). All major frontend flows working: hero/CTAs, WhatsApp FAB with correct number, language toggle EN<->TE, all 5 nav pages render, Tools calculators (SIP/Retirement/Goal) with sliders+charts, lead forms on /services and /contact, blog list with 6 cards + detail by slug, admin login and dashboard.

minor.issue: Public lead endpoints accept arbitrary dict payload (no Pydantic body model) - extra fields are silently ignored via model_config extra='ignore'. Consider validating body via typed model in the route signature for OpenAPI docs accuracy.
Only 'status' field is allowed; if payload contains only disallowed keys returns 400 'No valid fields' which is correct, but unauthenticated requests to PATCH return 401 only when token absent. OK.

issues: Recharts emits console warning 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first mount. Cosmetic only - charts render correctly after first paint. Consider giving ResponsiveContainer a minHeight or aspect prop.

action_items: (Optional) Suppress Recharts ResponsiveContainer width=-1 warnings by setting minHeight/aspect on charts in Tools.jsx.
(Optional) Replace `payload: dict` in /api/leads/* endpoints with typed Pydantic input models for stricter validation and OpenAPI clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 514 lines and contains models, routes, seeding and helpers - consider splitting into modules (models.py, auth.py, routes_public.py, routes_admin.py, seed.py) when it grows further.

Auth uses JWT in Authorization header + localStorage on the client (per spec). No httpOnly cookies - fine because the request states JWT/localStorage explicitly. CORS is wide-open allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True which is a browser anti-pattern; restrict to known origins for production.
Seed admin password update on mismatch is good (idempotent). bcrypt hash format $2b$ confirmed via login working.
Blog slug uniqueness is enforced by unique index plus uuid suffix - safe.
All Mongo reads correctly project out _id (good).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests POSTed TEST_ prefixed leads/contact and round-tripped a TEST_ blog/testimonial/FAQ (created+updated+deleted). The leftover 3 TEST_ leads + 1 contact remain in DB (small, harmless).
